answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Accredited ship keeper dock record with ship keepers verification — 3-year training, 474 supervised keepings, science exam, annual re-assessment. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 116 POA and 15 minutes each, 67164 POA and 8685 minutes in all. A harbor without a date is a rumour, a cedar without a receipt is a boast, and a mirror without a witness is a story. A farm cannot borrow a history, rent a credential, or forge a calendar.
